reviews.review_title: We do need more games like this!
reviews.review_description:
The type of game this is and the care that the developer has put into this is evident. This was quite a huge undertaking to say the least for a single indie developer. I do however want to leave a totally honest review...

The good: 
The graphics are decent and immersive, the story is engaging and has an eerie vibe throughout, the puzzles are clever without being overly frustrating and definitely gives you that feeling of satisfaction when they are completed. The amount of hours to uncover the story is a good amount of time for a game like this. There is a sitting mode and the game keeps you wanting to find out more. No dying, weapons, zombies, or stealth missions. No mazes thank goodness. There is a free demo to try before you buy. The developer is highly engaged, welcomes feedback and is constantly working on improvements. 
Most of all, the price.

The bad:
This needed a little more time to cook before release. The controls are non responsive in a lot of areas. You can see through walls, no collision through most objects and a lot of things that you cannot interact with. There is no self save mode, there is auto save but it doesn't always save correctly You move even slower than an actual person walks. There are bugs that make you restart a chapter, puzzles that won't trigger when you solve them and I found myself having to redo chapters and uninstalled and reinstalled a few times. 

The good news is the developer listens, is actively fixing all the issues anyone is experiencing and also takes feedback and suggestions and is implementing what the player wants. I would still highly recommend this, but it is not perfect and as long as you don't expect the room, red matter and ghost town type mechanics and graphics, it's one not to miss for any narrative driven puzzle adventurer.

I enjoyed the demo but the actual game has me frustrated enormously. Kept on crashing when trying to .progress. Just left with white hands. Twice I have uninstalled and reinstalled to try to fix. Also menu only opens behind me which is very strange. Recentre does not fix. Unfortunately I am too late for refund  but will not be trying to play this again. Very disappointing
Update:
Now fixed and the experience just what i expected. Just the right level of difficulty for me. Good fun

Just when you think we can’t get more story adventure puzzle games, along pops Closer Look VR
Set in a university the dark empty moody atmosphere sets the tone.

I played some of the demo but stopped as I didn’t want to spoil the full release, this isn’t a game to rush through, take your time & enjoy  the quiet uneasy feeling that something  bad may happen at any point.

I am really enjoying the my time so far, when I stop I just want to go back in to explore & see how the story develops, I’m totally into the character I play, this a great immersive experience on par with Ghost Town, eerie but not scary.
Fully recommended to fans of puzzle games.

I adore puzzle games. I want to adore A Closer Look. I don't. While I very much enjoy the puzzles, some are more challenging than others, and a lot of the esthetics, and I appreciate the talent and time that has gone into the game's development, I do not adore the glitches such as the game loading incorrectly, freezing up, locking my headset, and spawning into walls and furniture. They make playing very unadorable. I reached out to the Dev via Discord and was told that there are definitely some known, "rare" problems and a fix is being developed. I'm choosing to uninstall the game for now and will wait until the fix and update are available. 🤷‍♀️ I look forward to the update! This game has a ton of potential!

developer_response.body:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out and I’m sorry you’ve run into this issue. I am glad to hear you’ve been enjoying the game!

I’ve just pushed an update addressing this and a few other bugs. Please update the game to the latest version. I sincerely apologize for the lost progress and any frustration caused.

Thank you again for the honest feedback.

Please let me know how it goes after the update.

reviews.review_description:
I sure enjoyed this game.   Wow just wow.  
One of the best ones I’ve played in a while.     A couple little weird quirks, but nothing that was too serious.      I did not want it to end.      Thank you so much for your time on this. It was absolutely fabulous.     I am looking forward to more.     Kudos x a million!!!!!!!!

CloserLook VR: Oldways is a standout escape room experience that strikes the perfect balance between accessibility and intrigue. Whether you're a VR novice or a seasoned puzzler, the game’s difficulty curve is just right—challenging enough to engage but never frustratingly obscure.
The story unfolds like a slow-burn mystery, with clues dripped subtly into the environment, rewarding attentive players with satisfying "aha!" moments. The execution is polished, from the intuitive controls to the immersive atmosphere that shifts seamlessly between eerie and cozy settings.
A standout feature is the in-game map, which helps you keep your bearings without feeling like a crutch—it’s a thoughtful addition that enhances the experience rather than detracting from it. The variety of environments and puzzles ensures that every corner of Oldways feels fresh, and the demo is a fantastic way to get a taste of what’s to come.
What truly sets Oldways apart is its believability—the world feels genuine, the puzzles logical, and the narrative cohesive. It’s a game that respects your time and intelligence, making it a must-play for escape room enthusiasts and VR newcomers alike. If you’re looking for an escape room that’s as immersive as it is clever, look no further. 🏡🔓

reviews.review_title: VR needs more games like this!
reviews.review_description:
First of all, it’s amazing that this entire experience was created by a single developer! 

What intrigued me in the demo absolutely did not fully prepare me for where this exploration, puzzle, mystery, experience would take me. 

Every chapter offers a little something I didn’t expect and a whole lot of awe! 

Extremely rich in atmosphere, this is a great ‘take your time and fully immerse yourself in the mystery’ type of game and not your typical shoot 'em up.  

And yes, there are collectible artifacts to find!

There is a Strong sense of atmosphere and curiosity.

I loved the combination of exploring, puzzles and story.

The puzzles are clever and engaging. 

When you start playing, time flies. You just want to keep on going.

I didn’t expect the end….

Bought this game in order to support a solo developer but boy was I surprised, it's a real gem! Very compelling story and gameplay, plus the developer is extremely responsive and you can only appreciate the passion and effort that was put into this!
Kudos to the dev for a winning title, can't recommend enough!

An absolute masterpiece and by a solo developer?! The story is amazing, and the puzzles are genuinely smart and perfectly woven into the narrative. I loved that it took hours to beat and was priced perfectly. I will be the first in line to support and buy whatever this dev makes next—keep them coming!congrats to this amazing developer10/10, it’s everything I lov in a game and rare hidden gem for sure!!Bought early and the second I played the demo I was sold COULDNT wait and didnt  disappoint guys! Just get it! No brainer here🤓
WOW! Such a wonderful game. I had blast. The artifacts are beautiful, i would recommend this game to others. Keep them coming cause I'll keep playing them. 🥰🥰

Closer Look VR: Oldways combines mystery, exploration, and puzzles with an immersive atmosphere that keeps you invested throughout the experience.

You play as Tessy, a university student who wakes up in a mysterious building with no idea how she got there. As you explore, uncover clues, and solve puzzles, the story gradually unfolds, revealing the mystery behind your surroundings.

The game looks good and the story is really intriguing.
We need title like this (instead of killing and running!).
The game,unfortunately, has some minor bugs
(ex: I could look inside walls), I had to restart the device once (but maybe it was only bad luck) and I found a video inside the game without subtitles!
Anyway, it "smells" like a full 5 stars game!

The game appears to be broken. I had left the game when I was in the glasshouse. The next time I open the game I chose continue and I find myself in a totally black space but my hands are bright white. None of the controls work. I have restarted the quest 3 several times but to no avail. I have declined to start a new game because of the time I have invested. Can you advise? I enjoyed the demo and am otherwise happy with the game.

developer_response.body:
Thank you for the feedback. I'll investigate and fix the issue. I suspect you are falling off the map, for a temporary fix... try using stationary mode or recentre your VR headset. 

If the issue persist please join my discord so I can understand the problem better. sorry for the glitch in your experience.

https://discord.gg/Mfmp536fy

UPDATE
I’ve just pushed an update that addresses this problem, along with a few other bugs. Please update the game to the latest version.

I sincerely apologize for the lost progress and any frustration this may have caused. We truly appreciate your honest feedback, it helps me improve the game.

reviews.review_description:
I remember playing the demo of this and happy to see a lot of improvements. Like adding smooth turning.  Sadly, other improvements I had hoped for never came. Like subtitles. This is the second VR game I played today with forced subtitles?!  This is virtual reality!! While I believe subtitles should be an option for some players, it should never be a forced/default.  Massively immersion breaking

There also seems to be a lot of hitching and fps issues.  While I understand this is quest, I hope that gets smoothed out and/or qgo fixes this for them.

This game appears to rely heavily on AI, too.  So of this is an issue for players, you have been warned.

As for the game itself; its good.  I wouldn't call this an escape room, like most are calling it.  More like a walking simulator-story driven puzzle game.  Some graphics are crystal clear, while others are blurry with illegible text. Very odd mix, but I understand why.

Hopefully the game gets ironed out and we are given an option to remove the horrible subtitle box...

I love these types of games. The demo had me hooked and I couldn't wait for the full version. It did not disappoint ! A beautiful story that flowed and had me tear up at the end. The environment was so cool and the puzzles so engaging, I couldn't put it down.  The update notice came on my birthday and I spent the next day finishing it.  I can't say enough about how much I fully enjoyed this game. Do give it a go, you won't be disappointed.  An amazing achievement for this solo developer and I look forward to seeing more.

Great puzzle game that reminds me of Ghost Town. This is an indie game by a solo developer and cannot compete in overall polish of course. But the graphics are astonishingly good. Better than you would expect from a Quest game. Story and atmosphere are also excellent. The puzzles are rather on the easy side. All quite logical with hints to find in the environment.

Update: Finished the game! It was completely amazing. So unique. Loved the puzzles. Really loved the story. Loved the visuals. I'm sad I'm finished:( . I did update the game, which fixed my problem with the elevator code. I would have done that immediately, but I was under the impression my headset updated them automatically. That's not the case. After updating, I noticed smooth turn and fast movement which made the game even more enjoyable. I started over to take in the whole game in one run. Again, it's absolutely amazing. Totally worth the wait! Amazing job! I wish quest would advertise it. I'm sure it would be a huge hit if everyone could see it in the store. 

.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for the kind words about my project. I really appreciate it.

Try updating the app, then try the tip for the elevator controls again. We are uploading an official walk-through in the coming week but there is an unofficial one you can use on youtube. if you still can't find the correct code, join the discord with the link below:

https://discord.gg/Mfmp536fy

reviews.review_description: Excellent game. Love the African theme and story. I was invested in the characters from the start. Puzzles are well thought out and make sense in context. Well worth time and purchase.

I dropped in long enough to get a feel and boy it feels great. The visuals are brillant, everywhere you look, there's something worth stopping to admire.

The gameplay is simple but engaging and the puzzles challanging enough but not so hard that is spoils the fun, encouraging you to explore at your own pace and appreciate the world around you. It feels natural, relaxing making it easy to lose track of time as you wander through each area.  I cant wait to get back further into the story and see how it unfolds.

This is an easy five stars and you really want it to add to your VRlibrary.
But some spanish text appears in german. Hope you can fix this. Anyway great work. Good luck with the game!

developer_response.body: Thank you for the feedback, I'll investigate and fix this immediately

reviews.review_description: So, I could list all the little glitches I came across in this game, including the words that were misspelled, lol, but the story! Wow. The story is so amazing and full of details that the glitches just don't really bother me that much. It does interrupt the immersive experience, but the glitches are pretty small. The little recordings and documents that you find along the way just add even more layers to an already rich storyline. I'm so impressed with this game!! I loved playing it, and foresee that it'll be a game I play again and again. There was a bit of a creepy factor,  which I don't usually enjoy  - but this was superbly done. I love it! Awesome job and can't wait to see more games from this dev!

I put this on, not quite sure what to expect… thought it would be a pop on, play a bit and then exit… but nooooooo Look Closer VR had other plans for me…. I found it hard to pull myself away… the immersion, interesting story and even the very good graphics and sound, kept me firmly rooted in the game.

The puzzles are decent, not too hard, some have you running backwards and forwards… but they are quite logical, and kinda just one step after the other.

There is the odd little glitch, but they dont detract from the game or enjoyment playing it.
I do wish there was a sprint or walk faster button, as the pace when going backwards and forwards can be a little monotonous.

This is one of the top puzzlers on the Quest.. and I’d recommend it if you like puzzlers.
